summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a mandate letter with Natixis CIB to lead a fully underwritten 7-year senior secured structured project finance facility of $330 million for development and construction of the Corani Silver Project in Peru. A cost overrun facility of up to $100 million is to be provided by the Company prior to first draw; final amounts are subject to due diligence. Closing is expected in Q1 2027. This is a routine debt financing announcement, not a special situation.
